gap: A large CSV kept as an original is read whole inside the POST .../sources/{sourceId}/table request (G13); a dropped connection loses the work. Scope addition: a kept original of 16 MiB or less (CSV or XLSX) becomes a table synchronously; an XLSX above 16 MiB is refused in its own words.

change.why: tableFromOriginal only: admits with the same pins, replay key and refusals; a CSV above 16 MiB queues one table-profile job (202, stable id from source revision and request key); 16 MiB or less is read whole with inspectTabularSource and attached in the request; an XLSX above 16 MiB is refused. The accepting step (same receipt, same row, revision check, event) becomes one exported function the job reuses.
